P9 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
SIGNOR is literature curation, so an edge absent from it is not a proven non-edge.
Every AUC here is against SAMPLED negatives and is a lower bound by an unknown
amount, exactly as loop 177's H8 said about genomic decoys.
SIGNOR and OmniPath overlap by 14,635 edges, so recovering SIGNOR does not
independently confirm OmniPath and no claim below treats it as two results.
Reciprocity is measured on THIS network's edge set. A network assembled from
different sources would have a different base rate, and loop 187 already showed
the curated and binding tiers disagree on feedforward by 22 sigma.
Nothing here is a time course: predicting that an edge EXISTS is not predicting
what it DOES, and loop 198 measured that this project cannot step state forward.
